propositions: Valid code commit SHAs are incorrectly rejected when REBAR_TRACKER_DIR relocates the ticket store outside the code checkout because code_root_for derives the code repository from dirname(tracker) instead of the actual code root.
attach_commits passes the tracker path to commit_impact.unresolvable_shas, which then performs git rev-parse in the tracker parent directory rather than the code repository.
Code commit validation must resolve against the code repository independently from tracker storage, determined by explicit repo_root parameter, REBAR_ROOT environment variable, or cwd Git top-level.
Unknown/invalid commit SHAs must remain rejected with all-or-nothing semantics and no partial COMMITS event recorded.
code_root_for and unresolvable_shas functions are obsolete and must be removed to prevent the invalid tracker-parent derivation from being reused.
